name: Mini Cart for WooCommerce – Side Cart & Fast Checkout
author: Sharabindu

sections.description:
Mini Cart for WooCommerce adds a stylish, sliding mini cart (side cart) to your WooCommerce store. It lets customers view and manage their cart contents — without leaving the page they’re on.

A cart icon appears in your site’s menu bar and footer for one-click access. The moment a customer adds a product, the sidebar mini cart automatically opens, showing what’s inside and updating the cart icon count — all via AJAX, with zero page reloads.

If you run a WooCommerce store and want faster checkout, fewer abandoned carts, and a more modern shopping experience, this plugin is built for exactly that.

Key Features (Free)

  • Cart Icon Integration — Add a customizable cart icon to your site’s menu or footer.
  • Automatic Mini Cart Display — The mini cart slides in automatically when a product is added, giving instant visual feedback.
  • AJAX Add to Cart — Products are added without page reloads, for a smooth, fast shopping experience.
  • Animated Notifications — Visual cues confirm to customers that an item was added to the cart.
  • Shortcode Support — Place the cart icon anywhere on your site using a simple shortcode.
  • 16 Cart Icon Styles — Choose the icon that matches your store’s branding.

PRO Demo | Premium version | Documentation

Preview: Mini Cart Plugin for WooCommerce

How to Add a Cart Icon to Your Menu

There are two ways to add the cart icon to your navigation menu:

  • Method 1 (Free + Pro): Go to Mini Cart Settings in your dashboard, select a menu from the dropdown, and save. The cart icon appears at the end of that menu on the frontend. Docs
  • Method 2 (PRO Only): Go to Appearance > Menus, click Screen Options, and enable “Mini Cart for WooCommerce.” This lets you add the cart icon to multiple menus and control its exact position. Backend Demo

Footer/Body Cart Icon: A cart icon can also appear in your site’s footer, with 16 icon styles to choose from. You can hide it on specific pages or post types.

AJAX Add to Cart: No reload needed when a customer adds a product from the single product page — this speeds up the shopping flow, reduces server load, and improves overall site performance.

Extra Features in the PRO Version

All free features, plus:

Rewards Bar — Show a discount or free-shipping progress bar at the top of the mini cart. Run up to 2 reward tiers at once (e.g. “Spend $20 more for free shipping”).

Recommended Products — Show upsell, cross-sell, or suggested products directly in the cart, in 3 configurable positions — a proven way to increase average order value.

WooCommerce Shipping Calculator — Let customers enter their address and see the shipping cost instantly, before they reach checkout.

Coupon Form in Cart — Customers can apply a discount code without leaving the mini cart; totals update instantly.

Undo Remove Item — A temporary “Undo” link restores an accidentally removed product with one click.

Tax Display — Show the exact sales tax amount included in the cart total.

Quantity Increment Buttons — Smooth +/- controls for adjusting product quantity in the cart.

Flexible Menu Placement — Add the cart icon to multiple menus using the native WordPress Menu screen.

Stock Limit Notifications, One-Click Clear Cart, Multi-Currency Compatibility — and more.

See Pro Plans & Pricing →

  • Barcode Generator for WooCommerce — Generate barcodes for all products on your WooCommerce store.
  • YooBar – Top and Footer Notification Bar — Display attractive notification bars for offers, news, and announcements.

Privacy

This plugin does not connect to any third-party applications. It does not collect or store any user information.

sections.installation:
Step 1: Install the Plugin

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “Mini Cart for WooCommerce.”
  4. Locate the plugin by Sharabindu and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate.

Step 2: Configure the Plugin

  1. Once activated, a cart icon is automatically added to your site’s footer/body.
  2. To place the icon in your menu or customize it, go to Mini Cart Settings in your dashboard.
  3. Select a menu from the dropdown and choose from 16 available cart icon styles.
  4. Click Save.
sections.faq:
How can I display the cart icon on my website?

After activating the plugin, go to Mini Cart Settings in your dashboard. From there, choose where to show the cart icon (menu or body/footer) and pick your preferred icon style.

How do I add the cart icon to a menu / navigation bar?

Go to the plugin’s settings page, click the Menu Cart Icon tab, choose a menu from the dropdown, and save. Docs

Does this plugin work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes — Mini Cart for WooCommerce is built to work with most WordPress and WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Can I customize the cart icon?

Yes. The plugin includes 16 cart icon styles you can switch between from the settings panel.

Is the mini cart mobile-friendly?

Yes — the mini cart is fully responsive and works smoothly on smartphones and tablets.

What happens when a product is added to the cart?

A sliding mini cart appears instantly with the product you just added, along with an animated notification.

Are there extra features in the premium version?

Yes — Pro unlocks a rewards bar, recommended products, a shipping calculator, coupon form, tax display, quantity buttons, and more. Compare Free vs Pro →

Do I need a page builder to edit the mini cart?

No — all customization is done from the plugin’s settings page, no page builder required.

Does the free version work with WooCommerce out of the box?

Yes. Install, activate WooCommerce, then activate this plugin — no extra setup needed to get the sliding cart working.

How can I contact support?

Use the support forum for this plugin — we aim to respond quickly to every thread.
